kyoto_burisho.gf_detail: Ask. Yellowtail sashimi with soy or ponzu, tempura, Western and Chinese-style buri dishes, rolled cabbage and a Chaliapin steak; no gluten information is published (official menu; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_burisho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yellowtail specialist with A5 wagyu on the courses (official menu).
kyoto_burisho.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30 per the official site; Tabelog gives food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Tuesday (official site; Tabelog). Bookings taken; stays may be limited to 2.5 hours when busy (Tabelog); the premium lunch sets need booking (August 2026). Tabelog’s English page says a service charge is added, but its Japanese original reads 「なし」. 20 seats: a 14-seat counter and one private room (official site; Tabelog). Cards, transit IC and QR including Alipay and WeChat Pay (official site). On the 2nd floor of 松原クラタビル on Matsubara-dori east of Sakaimachi; about 10 min from Shijo, Gojo, Kyoto-Kawaramachi or Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (official site). Opened 1 March 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_burisho.notes: [Seafood · Matsubara, a whole menu of ice-aged yellowtail] A second-floor counter off Matsubara-dori devoted to one fish: Kagoshima's branded 鰤王 yellowtail, ice-aged to deepen its flavour and used nose to tail — sashimi tastings of different cuts, seared buri, buri in Western and Chinese styles, buri otoro sushi. Lunch sets run from ¥1,000 to multi-cut gozen; dinner courses from ¥6,500, the top ones adding A5 wagyu. Some diners find the cuts small for the price; most love the freshness. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Not named; operator 株式会社匠カンパニー (the invoice holder and site copyright)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: yellowtail that overturns expectations — Kagoshima’s brand buri 鰤王, ice-aged (氷熟) like meat to increase umami, used whole in many dishes; a 14-seat counter and one private room. The invoice number belongs to 株式会社匠カンパニー, which also holds the site copyright (2022). Opened 1 March 2022 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "鰤の常識を覆す" — to overturn what people expect of yellowtail.
chef_bio.specialty: Ice-aged yellowtail sashimi tasting; buri otoro sushi.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 lunch guest found many side dishes pre-made and still partly frozen, with the buri soboro overpowered by sesame.
A June 2026 diner was walked through each cut of yellowtail, including one topped with shaved karasumi.
An August 2026 diner liked the cuts but wished the slices were thicker, even at extra cost.

kyoto_teori_hilton.gf_detail: Ask. A buffet of Japanese, Western and Chinese dishes, curries, breads and desserts; no gluten labelling is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_teori_hilton.vegan_detail: Ask. The buffet has many dishes, but meat, seafood and dairy dominate; no vegan labelling is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_teori_hilton.hours_raw: Breakfast 7:00–10:00 (to 10:30 at weekends and holidays); lunch buffet 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00); dinner 17:30–21:30 (last order 21:00); à la carte 11:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); sweets buffets in the afternoon (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Prices include tax and service (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「表示料金には税金・サービス料が含まれております」). 120 seats, two private rooms free of charge; non-smoking, with a smoking area in the hotel; cards (Tabelog). Hilton members get 10% off (August 2026). On the 1st floor of Hilton Kyoto, with a bonfire visible outside; about 2 min from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; August 2026). Opened 12 September 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_teori_hilton.notes: [Buffet · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, Hilton Kyoto's all-day restaurant] The big, bright buffet restaurant on the ground floor of Hilton Kyoto, opened in 2024, with a fire burning outside. Lunch (about ¥5,800–6,200) brings carved herb-roast beef, tapas on house baguette, fried rice and well-liked curries; seasonal sweets buffets of mango, melon or chocolate pack the afternoons. Prices include service; Hilton members get 10% off. Busy with overseas visitors; private rooms free for groups.

roles: Hotel restaurant of Hilton Kyoto; chef not named
chef_bio.background: The all-day dining restaurant of Hilton Kyoto, opened 12 September 2024 (Tabelog). The hotel’s Osteria Italiana Seven Embers is a separate record.

kyoto_tsukumo_udon_shiokoji.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat-udon shop with free tenkasu and tempura (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_tsukumo_udon_shiokoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the broth is iriko (dried sardine) dashi, and the free topping is fried iriko (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_tsukumo_udon_shiokoji.hours_raw: 7:00–22:00 daily (last order 21:30); open year-round (Tabelog). No bookings; buy a ticket from the machine, order, then find a seat; queues of 7–10 minutes at peak lunch (2026 reviews). No charge (Tabelog’s Japanese original: なし). 35 seats: 21 at counters (some standing) and 14 at tables; non-smoking; English menu; children and strollers welcome; cards, transit IC and QR (Tabelog; October–November 2026). Inside JR Kyoto Station on basement level 2, by the east exit, in front of the JR gates (Tabelog; November 2026). Opened 27 July 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_tsukumo_udon_shiokoji.notes: [Udon · Kyoto Station, iriko udon from 7 a.m.] A busy udon counter on the second basement level of JR Kyoto Station, by the east exit, open from 7:00 — handy before a Shinkansen. Homemade noodles come in a clear iriko broth made from Kujukushima anchovies; the hit is the creamy chicken-and-egg curry udon (about ¥900), and kake udon is about ¥400. Help yourself to free tenkasu and crunchy fried iriko. Buy a ticket, order, then grab a seat. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: homemade noodles with an iriko dashi of anchovies caught around Kujukushima, Nagasaki. Opened 27 July 2018 (Tabelog). The invoice number belongs to 株式会社神戸ゴマルゴ (NTA corporate-number site); つくもうどん 天神橋店 in Osaka is the only other branch in the Tabelog crawl.
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken-and-egg curry udon; kake udon with free fried iriko.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular on an 11th visit always orders the kake udon and noted it rose from ¥360 to ¥400.
An October 2026 diner warns the spicy sauce of the curry udon sits at the bottom, so mix well.
A late-evening October 2026 diner found the chicken tempura smaller than expected and the total over ¥1,000 high for a standing udon shop.

kyoto_ryuen_italian.vegan_detail: Ask. Kyoto and farm vegetables feature, but most dishes use cheese, cured meat, fish or meat; no vegan dish is named (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ryuen_italian.hours_raw: 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Thursday plus a few irregular days a month (Tabelog). Bookings taken, also through Tabelog; times may be adjusted when busy (Tabelog; August 2026). 21 seats: a counter of 5 and 16 at tables; fully non-smoking; cards; private hire by phone (Tabelog). Portions are large — staff warn solo diners (May 2026). A Japanese-style building on Sanjo-dori west of Muromachi; 5 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog; July 2026). Over 20 years in business (October 2026).
kyoto_ryuen_italian.notes: [Italian · Sanjo-Muromachi, generous plates and good wine] A long-running Italian behind a Japanese-style front on Sanjo-dori, with a handwritten menu built on Kyoto and farm vegetables and an excellent wine list. Regulars return for the salmon and nagaimo tartare, the cheese risotto finished in a Parmigiano wheel and house-sliced prosciutto; portions are large, so share. About ¥8,000–15,000 a head. Dinner only; closed Thursday.

roles: Not named in any source found
chef_bio.background: An October 2026 reviewer notes over 20 years of history. Tabelog’s introduction highlights meat with Kyoto vegetables, fish with fruit tomatoes, generous starters and an excellent wine selection.
chef_bio.specialty: Salmon and nagaimo tartare; Parmigiano-wheel risotto.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 solo diner was warned that portions are large, ordered too much anyway, and still found it good value.

kyoto_bushido_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. A rice bowl of shaved bonito eaten with dashi soy, with miso soup and pickles; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_bushido_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the dish is bonito flakes, with egg and a dashi for ochazuke (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_bushido_sanjo.hours_raw: 7:00–15:00 daily (Tabelog); an August 2026 diner was told it is open until 14:30. Reservations accepted, advised at weekends; the B set needs a reservation, and early arrivals may be asked to come back at the booked time (Tabelog; October 2025, May 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; May 2026). 15 seats: a 6-seat counter downstairs and tables upstairs (Tabelog; September and December 2025). At the end of a narrow alley in the 三条食彩ろぉじ lane off Sanjo; 6 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog; November 2025).
kyoto_bushido_sanjo.notes: [Bonito rice bowl · Sanjo, breakfast from 7 a.m.] At the end of a narrow alley off Sanjo, a cook shaves katsuobushi to order and piles it in a fluffy mound over rice: eat it plain, then with egg and dashi soy, then as chazuke. ¥1,000–1,200 with miso soup and pickles. Reviews are mixed — some found the rice too soft and the broth thin, and a September 2026 diner reported a dirty restroom and dusty upstairs room. Cash only; 7:00–15:00 daily.

roles: Shop of the BUSHIDO brand (Tokyo and Utsunomiya shops on Tabelog); staff unnamed
chef_bio.background: Tabelog lists BUSHIDO TOKYO (Awajicho) and BUSHIDO UTSUNOMIYA under the same name; a March 2026 diner compared it with an often fully booked Shibuya shop. A November 2025 diner found one staff member running the counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Freshly shaved bonito rice bowl.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner waited about 25 minutes upstairs, noticed dust and a smell from an uncleaned restroom, and found the previous day’s rubbish and no toilet paper there.
A May 2026 diner found lukewarm self-serve water, blood spots in the bonito flakes, and a chazuke broth almost like hot water, though the miso soup and pickles were good.
A September 2025 diner found the rice mushy and the poured broth diluted, and saw no value for money.
A March 2026 returning diner missed the lively bonito-shaving show of five years earlier but found the flavours as good as ever.

kyoto_mono_mono_cafe.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable-heavy galettes are on the menu, but most come with egg, ham, bacon or cheese (2026 reviews).
kyoto_mono_mono_cafe.hours_raw: 11:00–18:30 (last order 17:30), closed irregularly — see the official Instagram (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; 90-minute limit when booked up (Tabelog; June 2026). Lunch set of galette, mini crepe and drink on weekdays (June 2026); another June 2026 diner describes lunch as weekend-only — check. No service charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「なし」). 34 seats on two floors, with sofas (Tabelog; March and August 2026). Cash or PayPay; no cards (Tabelog). A renovated Meiji-era townhouse on Karasuma-dori north of Shijo; 1 min from Karasuma Stn exit 22 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 7 January 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_mono_mono_cafe.notes: [Galettes & crepes · Karasuma Shijo, a Meiji townhouse café] A café of galettes and crepes in a renovated Meiji-era townhouse a minute from Karasuma Station, with sofas among the plants upstairs. The lunch set — a vegetable-packed galette, a mini crepe and a drink — is good value; the crepes come in plain or matcha batter. One diner found the simplest crepe forgettable. Cash or PayPay. Open 11:00–18:30.

chef_bio.background: Opened 7 January 2021 in a renovated Meiji-era townhouse (Tabelog; September 2026).

kyoto_sushi_komatsu.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi and sashimi with soy and sauces, plus tempura and fried dishes (2025–26 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_sushi_komatsu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and seafood counter (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_komatsu.hours_raw: 11:30–21:00 straight through (last orders food 20:00, drinks 20:30); closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; phone even when online slots are full; a booking more than 30 minutes late is cancelled (Tabelog). Walk-ins sometimes seated (October 2026). À la carte; the menu shows no prices, a diner noted (October 2026). 15 seats round a U-shaped white-wood counter; groups up to 5 (Tabelog; May and October 2026). Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Down a narrow alley; 6 min from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; February 2025). Opened 1 October 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sushi_komatsu.notes: [Sushi · Kyoto Station, a tuna wholesaler's counter, open all day] A white-wood U-shaped counter down an alley north of Kyoto Station, run by a tuna wholesaler and open straight through from 11:30 — handy for a late lunch. Order à la carte: rare tuna cuts, uni, guji, then tempura of anago or seasonal vegetables. Friendly chefs; prices aren't on the menu, but two people paid about ¥24,000–30,000 for a full meal. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Chefs (unnamed); formerly at Sushi Masahiro at Kyoto Station (April 2026 review)

A March 2026 diner came at 15:30 after missing lunch elsewhere and was glad it stays open.

kyoto_moan_yoshidayama.gf_detail: Ask. Drinks, cakes, kakigori and a hot sandwich of anko and mochi on bread; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_moan_yoshidayama.vegan_detail: Ask. Teas, coffee and kakigori with fruit syrups are likely options, but the sandwich has butter and the cakes are baked (2026 reviews).
kyoto_moan_yoshidayama.hours_raw: Wed–Sun 12:00–17:00; closed Monday and Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations: the official site says the café does not take reservations (「茂庵カフェはご予約をお受けしておりません。」) and can be full on fine spring and autumn days — phone or check the website for seats; Tabelog says weekend and holiday bookings are taken for up to an hour, and several 2026 diners booked. No food menu, light meals included (official site): drinks, cakes, cookies, kakigori in summer (2026 reviews). Card: AMEX only (Tabelog). 35 seats on the upper floor with windows over the city; shoes off (Tabelog; April 2026). Cars only to the foot of Yoshida-yama; a 15-minute walk up from the Jodo-ji or Ginkaku-ji bus stops, about 30 minutes from Demachiyanagi (Tabelog; official site).
kyoto_moan_yoshidayama.notes: [Café · Yoshida-yama, tea in the treetops] A Taisho-era building at the top of Yoshida-yama, reached only on foot — a 15-minute climb from the Ginkaku-ji side — where the upstairs room opens on all sides to the forest and the city below. Drinks, cakes and an anko-mochi butter sandwich, kakigori in summer; no meals. The official site says no reservations and it fills on fine days; Tabelog says weekend bookings for an hour. Wear sneakers. Wed–Sun 12:00–17:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a café reached only on foot at the top of Yoshida-yama, serving no meals. An April 2026 diner says the building dates from the Taisho era and is a Kyoto City registered tangible cultural property; it opened a tea room and an underground pantry for the Kyoto Modern Architecture Festival (October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Anko-mochi butter sandwich; kakigori.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor came on a pilgrimage to a location from an NHK BS drama and found a lively group of older women a bit overwhelming before the birdsong returned.
An April 2026 hiker found the path steep enough to leave a gym-goer out of breath.
During the October 2026 Kyoto Modern Architecture Festival, pork miso soup and rice balls were served outside.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (mo-an.com): 車は吉田山のふもとまで、どのルートでも最後は徒歩、茂庵カフェは予約を受けていない、春・秋・晴れの日は満席になることもある、空席状況は電話かサイトで、軽食を含む食事メニューの提供はない。食べログ: カフェ、左京区吉田神楽岡町8 吉田山山頂、浄土寺・銀閣寺バス停から徒歩15分、水〜日 12:00〜17:00、月・火曜休み、土日祝は最大1時間の予約可、35席、禁煙、カードは AMEX のみ。口コミ (2026年4〜10月、英語): 大正時代の建物で京都市の登録有形文化財、2階から市街の眺め、あんこと餅のバターホットサンド、抹茶アイス、かき氷、柚子ソーダ、Kyoto Modern Architecture Festival。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk up in good shoes; check seats by phone or website; AMEX is the only card.

kyoto_tendon_loosen_up.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat-battered tempura over rice with a sweet soy sauce, including nama-fu (wheat gluten) tempura (2026 reviews).
kyoto_tendon_loosen_up.vegan_detail: Not vegan: tendon bowls with shrimp, scallop, eel and cheese tempura; tencha finished with dashi (2026 reviews).
kyoto_tendon_loosen_up.hours_raw: Tuesday to Sunday and holidays 12:00–15:30 and 17:30–21:00 (food last order 20:30); closed Monday and irregularly — the shop says to check Google Maps, as it sometimes opens on Mondays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); queues at opening (September 2026). 9 seats: 4 at a counter and 5 side by side facing the wall; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Cards, Suica and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). Allergy information available (Tabelog). Ground floor on Higashioji-dori near the Chion-in-mae bus stop, a couple of minutes north of Yasaka Shrine; 7 min walk from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_tendon_loosen_up.notes: [Tendon · Higashioji by Yasaka Shrine, fifteen bites in a bowl] A nine-seat café-like counter north of Yasaka Shrine frying tendon to order: the "Hannari" bowl of fifteen bite-sized tempura — a big shrimp, nama-fu, cheese, scallop, vegetables — is ¥1,600, with eel as an upgrade and a chilled tencha finish for ¥300 more. Bright, friendly staff; popular with visitors from abroad; queues at opening. Closed Monday (sometimes open — check Google Maps).

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a tendon shop "crafted with care by a chef from a Japanese cuisine background" (September 2026), a bright manager and staff (August 2026), a Western-style name and interior, and a room where an August 2026 family were the only Japanese guests.
chef_bio.specialty: Hannari Ten-don; chilled tencha.

anecdotes.text: A party of five — mother, daughter, sister, niece and the reviewer — found it at 2 pm in August 2026 when other places were closing, and asked for the air-conditioning to be turned up.
"It was my first time trying eel tempura, and it was shockingly delicious." — September 2026.
"The manager and staff were bright and provided wonderful service." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 天丼・天ぷら・日本料理、東山区松原町290、祇園四条駅から徒歩8分、東山駅から徒歩7分、火〜日・祝 12:00〜15:30・17:30〜21:00 (料理L.O.20:30)、月曜と不定休 (月曜に営業することもあり、最新はGoogleマップで)、予約可、9席 (カウンター4、壁向きの5席)、禁煙、Wi-Fi、カード・Suica・QR (Alipay、WeChat Pay も) 可、アレルギー表示あり。口コミ (2026年2月〜9月、英語): 東大路通の知恩院前バス停の近く、八坂神社の北、はんなり天丼 (15種の一口天ぷら、大海老、生麩、チーズ、帆立) 1,600円、1,200円から、鰻の天ぷらも、冷やし天茶 +300円、和食出身の料理人、明るいスタッフ、開店前から行列、海外の客が多い。

kyoto_cafe_malda.gf_detail: GF options: the official menu labels two rice-flour muffins gluten-free (maple; matcha with adzuki), and the almond gelato is made with rice flour; the lunch curry comes with organic brown and black rice. Wheat muffins (maple, banana-cocoa-coconut) are baked in the same kitchen every day, so ask about cross-contact (official site, 2026; October 2026 review).
kyoto_cafe_malda.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: all desserts are made with no sugar, egg or dairy (official menu), and the gelatos are dairy-free. The lunch curry is vegetarian but served with raita (yogurt), and the chai contains milk — the menu says "not vegan" (official site, 2026).
kyoto_cafe_malda.hours_raw: Wednesday to Sunday 11:30–19:00, lunch 11:30–14:00; closed Monday and Tuesday (official site). Tabelog gives 11:30–17:00. No reservations (Tabelog). 8 seats around a large communal table, counter and tables (Tabelog; December 2025). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) only for bills of ¥5,000 or more (Tabelog). English menu; takeaway muffins and cookies (Tabelog; September 2026). Ground floor of Hotel MALDA, a three-room inn, on Sakaimachi just south of Oike; 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 3 (official site; Tabelog). Opened July 2018 (official site).
kyoto_cafe_malda.notes: [Café · Sakaimachi Oike, egg-, dairy- and sugar-free baking] The Babaghuri brand's café under its three-room inn: a calm, wooden room where everything sweet — muffins, cookies, gelato — is made without sugar, egg or dairy, with gluten-free rice-flour muffins. Lunch is a vegetarian lentil-and-vegetable curry on brown and black rice (raita on the side) or a Taiwanese congee; herb teas from Lehl's Ishigaki farm. Cards only from ¥5,000. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: MALDA opened in July 2018 on Anekoji as a café and inn embodying the life philosophy of Babaghuri; desserts are baked in-house every morning without sugar, egg or dairy, and the lunch curry is a favourite from Jurgen Lehl's company canteen; seasonal fruit and herbs come from Jurgen Lehl's farm on Ishigaki Island. The inn upstairs takes three groups a day.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Simple, yet born over time from facing people, things and the environment honestly" — Babaghuri's philosophy of living (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Egg- and dairy-free muffins; vegetarian curry; congee.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 hotel guest received a vegan cookie as a welcome gift, went down to buy a tin, and found the tins sold out.

"After exercising, I pay special attention to what I eat" — an October 2026 visitor chose the congee with ginger and mozuku while recovering from a cold, noting the vegan options and rice-flour gluten-free sweets.
A September 2026 diner liked best the beet and chickpea hummus on the vegetarian curry plate.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: MALDA、2018年7月に姉小路通に開いたカフェと宿、ババグーリの生活哲学、カフェ・マルダは宿の1階、砂糖・卵・乳製品を使わないお菓子 (マフィン、クッキー) を毎朝手作り、ランチ (11:30〜14:00) は季節の野菜とレンズ豆のダールのマルダのカレー (オーガニック玄米と黒米、4種の付け合わせ、ライタ)、米粉のメープルマフィンと米粉の抹茶マフィン (グルテンフリー)、ローストアーモンドのジェラート (乳製品不使用)、ババグーリの豆茶、石垣島ヨーガンレール農園のレモングラス茶、チャイ (牛乳使用、ヴィーガンではない)、自然派ワイン、11:30〜19:00、月・火定休、京都市中京区堺町通御池下る丸木材木町684、宿は1日3組。食べログ: カフェ・洋菓子、烏丸御池駅3番出口から徒歩5分、水〜日、予約不可、8席、禁煙、カードは5,000円から、英語メニュー、テイクアウト、ベジタリアン対応、2018年7月23日オープン。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年11月、英語): 台湾風のお粥とねぎ餅、レモンとアールグレイの米粉マフィン410〜450円、チャイ700円、ベジカレー、ビーツとひよこ豆のフムス、金継ぎの器、ヴィーガンのクッキー。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog; official site is bilingual); cards only from ¥5,000.

gf_cross_contamination.text: Gluten-free rice-flour muffins are baked in the same kitchen as wheat muffins (maple, banana-cocoa-coconut) every day; no separation is described — ask before ordering if you are coeliac.

vegan_cross_contact.text: All desserts are free of egg and dairy, but the kitchen also prepares raita (yogurt) and milk chai.

positives.text: The official menu labels the rice-flour maple and matcha muffins gluten-free and states that all desserts contain no sugar, egg or dairy.

kyoto_cherie_maison_du_biscuit.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: biscuits, biscuit sandwiches, financiers and cakes made with wheat flour and fermented butter (2026 reviews).
kyoto_cherie_maison_du_biscuit.vegan_detail: Not vegan: baked goods built on fermented butter, with cream-filled biscuit sandwiches and cheese cookies (2026 reviews).
kyoto_cherie_maison_du_biscuit.hours_raw: Thursday and Friday 12:30–16:00; Saturday 12:30–16:30; closed Sunday to Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog; official site). Takeaway only for now — the salon is closed; no reservation needed to buy, but biscuit sandwiches are limited per person (Tabelog). Queues at opening (June 2026). Biscuit sandwiches must be refrigerated and keep about a week; online sales sell out fast (July 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). A white building on Takakura-dori north of Ebisugawa, south of the Imperial Palace; 4–5 min walk from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; official site; 2026 reviews). Opened 1 March 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_cherie_maison_du_biscuit.notes: [Biscuits · Takakura south of the Imperial Palace, a cult biscuit sandwich] A white-walled shop on Takakura-dori where confectionery researcher Kanae Kobayashi sells the famous biscuit sandwiches — crisp biscuits around cream, refrigerated, rationed per person and hard to buy online — plus fermented-butter biscuits, Parmigiano cookies and financiers, some in tins illustrated by Yuko Higuchi. Takeaway only for now; open Thursday to Saturday afternoons; queue at opening. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the shops of 小林かなえ, with books, media appearances and NHK sweets recipes listed; CHÉRIE MAISON DU BISCUIT sells sweets to take away, CHÉRIE CAFE serves soft serve, and CHÉRIE MAISON DU PARFAIT is a reservation-only parfait shop in a townhouse; the company recruits staff. A May 2026 reviewer calls the shop well known among dessert lovers in Kyoto. Per Tabelog: opened 1 March 2019.
chef_bio.specialty: Biscuit sandwich; Parmigiano cookies.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 visitor who had once left with only biscuits — not realising the famous sandwich was refrigerated — came back, queued before 12:30, and bought both.
An October 2026 buyer of Parmigiano cookies found the balance of cheese and sweetness "simply exquisite" and could not stop eating.
"As a lemon cake lover, I found it a bit lacking in lemon flavor, but as a baked sweet, it was truly delicious." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: CHÉRIE MAISON DU BISCUIT、小林かなえ、シェリーメゾンドビスキュイ (お菓子テイクアウト) 12:30〜16:00 (土16:30)、日・月・火・水定休、京都市中京区高倉通夷川上る福屋町733-2 (高倉通りの白いビル)、シェリーカフェ (ソフトクリーム、東洞院竹屋町)、シェリーメゾンドパフェ (完全予約制のパフェ店、竹屋町通の町家)、オンラインショップ、書籍、NHK のお菓子レシピ、スタッフ募集。食べログ: カフェ・洋菓子、木・金 12:30〜16:00、土 12:30〜16:30、予約不要で購入可、ビスキュイサンドは個数制限、現在サロンは休業しお菓子の販売のみ、7席、現金のみ、2019年3月1日オープン。口コミ (2026年5月〜11月、英語): 丸太町駅から徒歩4〜5分、御所の南、ビスキュイサンド (要冷蔵、日持ち約1週間、オンラインはすぐ完売)、発酵バター、パルミジャーノのクッキー、フィナンシェ、レモンケーキ、Yuko Higuchi のイラストの缶、開店前から行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway only; biscuit sandwiches rationed and refrigerated; cash only; open Thu–Sat afternoons.

kyoto_kamogawa_cafe.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee with scones, toast, cakes such as apple crumble, lasagna and a cheesy hamburg-steak gratin; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kamogawa_cafe.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee and a soy-milk chai appear, but the scones come with cream and the food uses cheese, butter and meat; no vegan information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kamogawa_cafe.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Friday 10:30–20:00; Wednesday 10:30–17:00; Saturday and Sunday 10:30–21:30; closed Thursday and the fourth Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Tabelog notes that lunch stopped in March 2024, with drinks and light meals continuing, though reviewers had a noon lunch and a hamburg gratin in 2025–2026. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 30 seats on the second floor with counter and sofas; non-smoking (Tabelog; August 2025). Takeaway coffee beans (August 2025). On a residential street a block off the main road near Kojinguchi; 3 min from the Kojinguchi bus stop, 10 min north of Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_kamogawa_cafe.notes: [Café · Kojinguchi, house-roast coffee upstairs] A high-ceilinged second-floor café on a quiet street near Kojinguchi and the Kamo, with colored-glass windows you open yourself, rakugo posters, books and magazines — a student-quarter coffee house roasting its own beans. The Kamogawa blend, scones with cream, an apple crumble, a smoothie-and-toast set; lunch is limited. Open late at weekends. Cash only. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a long-running café that roasts and sells its own beans, with high ceilings, colored-glass windows and posters for solo rakugo shows; a May 2026 regular says it was once known as "Sarasa Kamogawa" and thinks its operation may have changed (not confirmed elsewhere).
chef_bio.specialty: Kamogawa blend coffee; scone set.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 visitor came on the night of the Gozan Okuribi and was impressed by the low-acid, aromatic Kamogawa blend.
A November 2025 guest, back after eleven years, arrived before the noon lunch and had the scone set with fresh cream.
"I would be happy if there were more choices on the lunch menu." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、上京区西三本木通荒神口下ル上生洲町229-1、京阪丸太町駅から北へ徒歩10分、荒神口バス停から徒歩3分、大通りから一本入った住宅街、月・火・金 10:30〜20:00、水 10:30〜17:00、土・日 10:30〜21:30、木曜と第4水曜休み、予約不可、2024年3月からランチの提供をやめた (ドリンクと軽食は継続)、現金のみ、30席、禁煙、テイクアウト。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年9月、英語): 2階、自家焙煎の豆も販売、かもがわブレンド、スコーンのセット、トースト、スムージーのセット、りんごのクランブルケーキ、オニオングラタンとチーズのハンバーグ、15時以降のラザニア、豆乳のチャイ、落語のポスター、色ガラスの窓、以前は「Sarasa Kamogawa」と呼ばれていたとの声 (未確認)。

cultural_comfort.note: Second floor; cash only; limited food; open late at weekends.

kyoto_gion_nakahara.gf_detail: Ask when booking — the shop asks about likes, dislikes and foods guests cannot eat (August 2025); dashi-based kappo with tempura; no gluten information.
kyoto_gion_nakahara.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kappo of fish on dashi (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_nakahara.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday and on Mondays that are holidays (Tabelog). Bookings taken; a nine-course dinner runs about two hours (Tabelog; May 2025). 13 seats: six counter seats, a small raised area and a table; non-smoking; JCB, AMEX and Diners (Tabelog; 2024–25 reviews). Down a very narrow back alley in front of Yasaka Shrine, three streets west of Minami-za (2024–25 reviews).
kyoto_gion_nakahara.notes: [Kappo · Gion, down a narrow alley] A tiny kappo hidden in one of Gion's narrowest alleys near Yasaka Shrine: seasonal kaiseki with a rich Kansai dashi, finished with kamadaki rice. Mini kaiseki lunch about ¥5,000–6,000; dinner about ¥10,000–19,999. Six counter seats; book. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a couple ran the room with no other servers (March 2024); in August 2024 the owner worked with two apprentices. A November 2024 reviewer heard it had held a Michelin star four years in a row but no longer does.
chef_bio.specialty: Mini kaiseki lunch; kamadaki rice.

anecdotes.text: A March 2024 diner, there on a furusato-tax voucher, found it more like a calm izakaya than a kaiseki house, the couple working seamlessly but a little rushed.
An August 2025 guest was asked about likes, dislikes and any foods to avoid.
"I heard this place earned Michelin stars 4 years in a row, but it's no longer recognized." — November 2024.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園なか原、日本料理、東山区祇園町北側286-5、祇園四条駅から446m、月〜土 11:30〜14:00・17:00〜22:00、日曜と祝日の月曜休み、13席 (カウンター)、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)。口コミ (2024年3月〜2026年7月、英語): 八坂神社前の細い路地、夫婦で営む (2024年3月)、店主と弟子2人 (2024年8月)、ミシュランの星を4年連続で得たが今はない (2024年11月)、ミニ懐石の昼5,000〜6,000円、9品のコース、ひな祭りの八寸、蛤の吸い物、平目やぐじの造り、鯛の昆布締め、もろこ、ふぐ、筍、稚鮎とこしあぶらの天ぷら、鯛の酒盗、丸大根、九条ねぎ、釜炊きのご飯。

kyoto_blanca_izakaya.gf_detail: Ask. Kara-age, fried noodles, shumai and spiced fried dishes; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_blanca_izakaya.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: pork, chicken, lamb, shellfish and oysters run through the menu (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_blanca_izakaya.hours_raw: Mon–Sat from 18:00 (last order 21:00 per Tabelog); closed Sunday and some other days (Tabelog). A March 2025 reviewer says there is no time limit and the rice is ready around 21:00. Bookings for the next month open at the start of each month and are hard to get; Saturday walk-ins are possible if you arrive before opening, when the head chef may be away and the menu shorter (Tabelog; April 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 11 seats: 7 at the counter, 4 at a table; a private room for 6 for regulars, with a special course (Tabelog). North of Sanjo; 4 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_blanca_izakaya.notes: [Izakaya · near Sanjo and Kyoto City Hall] One of Kyoto's hardest-to-book izakaya, loved by restaurant people after hours: eleven seats and a stream of small, deeply flavoured plates — cilantro and white-sesame salad, lamb shumai, spiced fried shrimp, Thai-style noodles. About ¥4,000–10,000. Cash only; bookings open monthly; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Tetsu-san (as a November 2025 reviewer calls the chef)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a popular izakaya that restaurant workers visit after hours (May 2026); a November 2025 reviewer had eaten the chef's cooking at an inn the chef runs with a friend in Yura before coming here. When the head chef is away on Saturdays the staff run a shorter menu (April 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Cilantro and white-sesame dishes; small plates for drinking.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 regular walked in on a Saturday before opening, knowing walk-ins are possible then — though the head chef was off and the menu limited.
A June 2026 diner in Kyoto on a typhoon night phoned for a cancellation and got a table.
A party of five in November 2025 found a separate room next door and missed only chatting with Tetsu-san at the counter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ブランカ、居酒屋、中京区御幸町三条上ル丸屋町334、京都市役所前駅から248m、月〜土 18:00〜21:00 (L.O. 21:00)、日曜休み・不定休、翌月の予約は毎月はじめに受付、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、11席 (カウンター7、テーブル4)、常連向けの個室6名 (特別コース)、禁煙。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年7月、英語): パクチーと豚の白胡麻サラダ、パクチー白和え、ポテトナムル、唐揚げ、茹で豚、無花果と蒸し鶏、茄子の南蛮とところてん、貝の盛り合わせ、Miyazu の岩牡蠣、羊の焼売、イスラム風の海老フライ、タイ風焼きそば、金曜の特別コース6,000円、土曜は開店前なら予約なしでも、料理長 Tetsu-san、Yura の宿。

cultural_comfort.note: Hard to book (next month opens at the start of each month); cash only; mostly regulars (July 2026).

kyoto_yanaginobamba_hondatei.gf_detail: Ask. Dashimaki bowls with dashi, soy-based sauces and soboro; fish courses; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_yanaginobamba_hondatei.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg and dashi bowls with chicken, meat or eel; fish courses (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_yanaginobamba_hondatei.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) daily except Tuesday; dinner Mon 17:30–21:00, Wed–Sun and days before/after holidays 17:30–22:30 (food last order 21:30), holidays 17:30–21:30; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Lunch takes no bookings and is cash only (May 2026); dinner courses can be booked (Tabelog). Seat charge 10% — Tabelog's Japanese original: "別途、席料として10%頂いております。". 26 seats: about 10 at the counter and sunken-floor tables; non-smoking, smoking outside; cards incl. UnionPay (Tabelog; July 2026). On Yanaginobamba-dori; 3 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn exit 3-1 (Tabelog).
kyoto_yanaginobamba_hondatei.notes: [Dashimaki bowls & seafood · near Karasuma-Oike] By day, a queue for rice bowls crowned with a huge, wobbly Kyoto dashimaki omelette (about ¥1,430, cash, no bookings); by night, a fish restaurant with live-tank seafood, Goto-island kue hot pot and fugu, courses from ¥5,000 plus a 10% seat charge. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed; chats with guests at the counter per the operator and reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per the operator: fish kept alive in tanks and dispatched with ikejime by optical fibre; wild kue line-caught off Nagasaki's Goto Islands shipped alive; fugu from Awaji. A July 2026 reviewer watched the dashimaki made in the "Kyomaki" way, with more dashi and no air.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto dashimaki rice bowl; kue nabe.

anecdotes.text: The staff also recommended good matcha-parfait shops — February 2026.
An October 2026 diner found the bowl lovely at first but a little monotonous, and the staff's coordination slightly uneven.
Another October 2026 guest was offered the chance to film the sauce being poured.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 京都 柳馬場 ほん田亭、海鮮・日本料理、中京区柳八幡町75-6 LS京都ビル 1F、烏丸御池駅3-1出口から徒歩3分、昼11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 14:00)、夜 月17:30〜21:00、水〜日・祝前後17:30〜22:30、祝日17:30〜21:30、火曜休み、別途席料として10%、26席 (掘りごたつとカウンター)、カード可、生け簀の魚を光ファイバーで神経締め、Nagasaki の Goto Islands の一本釣りの天然クエの鍋、Awaji のふぐ、5,000円からの魚のコース、冬は鰤しゃぶと天然とらふぐ。口コミ (2026年1〜10月、英語): 京だし巻き丼 鶏そぼろ金あんかけ1,430円、肉そぼろ1,430円、明太子、鰻、京巻き、昼は現金のみ・予約不可。

cultural_comfort.note: Lunch: queue, cash only; dinner: book; 10% seat charge.

kyoto_bistro_yanagihara.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Bistro dishes with sauces, pâtés, bread and croutons; the omakase can be adjusted on request (December 2024); no gluten information.
kyoto_bistro_yanagihara.vegan_detail: Not vegan: charcuterie, foie gras, venison, salmon and trout (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_bistro_yanagihara.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun 17:30–21:30 (last order 19:30); closed Wednesday and Thursday (Tabelog). Bookings needed, often a month or two ahead, also online (2025 reviews). Service charge: none — Tabelog's Japanese original says "なし". 10 seats: tables and 2 at the counter; non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). Portions are large — staff suggest two starters and one main for two (2025–26 reviews). At Kawaramachi-Nijo; 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_bistro_yanagihara.notes: [French bistro · Kawaramachi-Nijo] A ten-seat bistro run by an Alsace-trained chef since 2010: generous charcuterie, thick-cut smoked salmon, foie gras and game, with good wine. Omakase ¥8,800 or à la carte (portions are large). Book well ahead; dinner only, closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Chef (unnamed; trained in Alsace per an April 2025 reviewer)
chef_bio.background: Opened 12 December 2010 (Tabelog). An April 2025 reviewer calls it a Bib Gourmand bistro run by a chef trained in Alsace; a December 2024 guest returned after about eight years.
chef_bio.specialty: Charcuterie; thick-cut smoked salmon.

anecdotes.text: An October 2024 birthday party praised the service of "the beautiful staff member (the owner's wife?)", though the crab tartare could have had more crab.
A December 2024 guest who could not eat much had the omakase adjusted so every dish could be enjoyed.
An April 2025 diner was advised that two starters and one main would be plenty.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビストロヤナギハラ、フレンチ・ビストロ、中京区河原町二条上る清水町358、京都市役所前駅から徒歩5分、月火金土日 17:30〜21:30 (L.O. 19:30)、水木休み、サービス料: なし、10席 (テーブル、カウンター2)、禁煙、カード可、2010年12月12日オープン。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年9月、英語): アルザスで修業したシェフ、ビブグルマン、シャルキュトリーの盛り合わせ1人1,540円、Shinshu サーモンの燻製3,080円、ホワイトアスパラ、マッシュルームのサラダ、フォアグラと鹿のガスパチョ、鱒のサフラン、鶏レバーのムース、おまかせコース8,800円、量が多い、予約は1〜2か月前。

kyoto_cocolo_kyoto.gf_detail: Ask. Granola usually contains oats and no gluten information is given; the black-shichimi nuts use an organic gluten-free tamari (official site), but other flavours are not labelled.
kyoto_cocolo_kyoto.vegan_detail: Ask. Organic nuts and granola, and soy-milk ice cream (January 2026), may suit; acai bowls come with fruit and granola, but no vegan labelling is given (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cocolo_kyoto.hours_raw: Official site: 11:00–19:00, closed Tuesday. Tabelog: daily 11:00–18:00; hours may change. The café stops serving at 17:00 (January 2026). Bookings taken (Tabelog). 16 seats; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Second floor; samples offered (2025–2026 reviews). Two more shops in Tokyo (Yurakucho Marui, Ginza Melsa) (official site).
kyoto_cocolo_kyoto.notes: [Granola & nuts café · Karasuma-Oike, upstairs] Kyoto’s first granola specialist, up a flight of stairs: organic nuts roasted in Kyoto with black shichimi from 原了郭, white miso, matcha or yatsuhashi cinnamon — boxed for souvenirs, with tastings — and acai bowls or soy-sauce ice cream to eat in. The café closes before the shop. One August 2026 buyer found them good, practical gifts rather than incredible; a black-pepper lover wanted more heat. Closed Tuesday (official site).

roles: Nut roasters in its own Kyoto factory (official site); not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the first granola specialist to open in Kyoto, treating granola as a health and beauty food with almost all-organic ingredients; nuts are roasted one by one by nut craftsmen in its factory in central Kyoto, adjusting for Kyoto’s seasons; flavours made with old Kyoto makers (原了郭 black shichimi, 九重味噌 white miso, 北尾 kinako, Uji matcha); shops in Kyoto and in Tokyo at Yurakucho Marui and Ginza Melsa.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「毎日食べてココロもカラダもHAPPYに」 — granola eaten daily to make heart and body happy.
chef_bio.specialty: Black-shichimi nuts; organic granola; acai bowls.

anecdotes.text: Arriving at 5:30 pm after the café had closed, a January 2026 visitor bought nuts instead and was given ice cream on the house.
"To be honest, I wouldn't say they were 'incredibly delicious' (sorry!), but they weren't excessively expensive either." — August 2026; long-keeping and light for souvenirs.
Someone who dislikes nuts kept buying the black-shichimi nuts as gifts, then tried them and became a fan (December 2025).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (cocolo-kyoto.jp): COCOLO KYOTO、京都に初めて誕生したグラノーラ専門店、毎日食べてココロもカラダもHAPPYに、グラノーラは健康食品・美容食品、ほぼすべての素材がオーガニック、京都市中心部の工場でナッツ職人が一粒ずつ焼く、祇園原了郭の黒七味と丸又商店のオーガニックグルテンフリーたまり醤油、九重味噌の極上白味噌、北尾の京・丹波ぶどう黒豆きな粉、宇治の有機抹茶、八ツ橋のニッキ、店舗は京都本店 (東洞院通三条下ル三文字町201、11:00〜19:00、火曜休み)、有楽町マルイ店、銀座メルサ店。食べログ: カフェ・スイーツ、中京区東洞院通三条下ル三文字町201 2F、毎日11:00〜18:00、予約可、16席、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年8月、英語): アサイーボウル、ナッツのトッピング、祇園黒七味ナッツ30g 700円・65g 1,290円、白味噌、八ツ橋、Nile Restaurant のカレー、Ogawa Coffee のコーヒー味、きな粉、のり、箱なしの割れナッツ、醤油と七味のアイス、豆乳とヘーゼルナッツのアイス、試食、カフェは17時まで、親切なスタッフ、お土産向き、驚くほどではないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Pick boxes from the shelves and taste first; café orders at the counter upstairs.

kyoto_manmaru_no_tsuki.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat-batter okonomiyaki, negiyaki and yakisoba with sauce (2026 reviews).
kyoto_manmaru_no_tsuki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the Kyoto-style okonomiyaki is rich with dashi and topped with bonito flakes (2026 reviews); Tabelog lists vegetarian options — ask.
kyoto_manmaru_no_tsuki.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); irregular closures. Bookings taken; a counter booking may be moved to the tatami room. 43 seats with a counter, sunken seating and semi-private rooms; private hire for 30–40; non-smoking with a smoking spot in front; children welcome; menus in English, Chinese and Korean; cards and PayPay (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Opened 1 December 2010 (Tabelog).
kyoto_manmaru_no_tsuki.notes: [Okonomiyaki & teppan · Shijo-Karasuma, Kyoto-style with a French twist] A stylish counter and sunken-seat room on Nishiki-koji where dashi-rich, fluffy Kyoto-style okonomiyaki shares the teppan with creative plates — avocado with blue cheese, grilled vegetables, Saikyo-miso pork — served on ceramics. Multilingual menus; staff warm and quick. Some found the yakisoba bland and the prices a little high for the taste (2026); you will leave smelling of sauce.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 December 2010 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a large teppan behind the counter, a sunken-seat area at the back for parties, regulars at the counter, Kyoto-style okonomiyaki and teppan dishes with French and Italian touches; an August 2026 diner found it via the Kansai TV programme "Yoi Don" featuring the mochi-cheese okonomiyaki.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-style okonomiyaki; creative teppan plates.

anecdotes.text: "The only downside is that by the time you leave, you'll smell like okonomiyaki from the sauce." — May 2026.
「味は全体的にまずまず。」 — November 2026, who still recommends it for a date, for the big teppan in front of you.
A June 2026 group celebrating a friend’s occasion had a message written on the dessert plate.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お好み焼き 鉄板焼き まんまるの月、お好み焼き・鉄板焼き・ステーキ、中京区錦小路通烏丸西入占出山町312 KEY’Sビル1F、四条駅・阪急烏丸駅から徒歩3分、毎日17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、不定休、予約可 (カウンター予約でも座敷になる場合あり)、43席、半個室、貸切30〜40名、禁煙 (店前に喫煙スペース)、子供可、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、ベジタリアン対応、カード・PayPay 可、2010年12月1日オープン。口コミ (2026年4月〜11月、英語・日本語): 京風お好み焼き、だしが効いてふわふわ、もちチーズ (関西テレビ「よーいドン」で紹介)、和牛、ねぎと海苔、ねぎ焼き、まんぼ焼き、焼き野菜の盛り合わせ、きのこ炒め、アボカドのブルーチーズ焼き、海老とブロッコリーのピリ辛マヨ、豚の西京焼き、オムレツ、海鮮サラダ、塩焼きそば、ポテトサラダ、誕生日のデザートプレート、焼きそばは薄味という声、少し高め・味はまずまずという声、ソースの匂いが残る。

kyoto_teramachi_yoshikura.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; lunch sets with tempura and dashi-simmered obanzai, Saikyo-miso grilled fish (2026 reviews).
kyoto_teramachi_yoshikura.vegan_detail: Not vegan: obanzai simmered in dashi and fish or beef mains (2026 reviews; official site).
kyoto_teramachi_yoshikura.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 11:00–14:00 (L.O.), dinner 17:00–21:00 (L.O.); closed Tuesday. Tabelog: 11:00–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00). Lunch is cash or PayPay only; cards at dinner (Tabelog). Bookings taken; lunch fills up, so book (October 2026). No service charge (Tabelog; Japanese original 「なし」). 20 seats: a counter of 10 and tatami rooms; non-smoking; children welcome but no nursing or changing facilities (Tabelog). Opened 13 November 2006 (Tabelog).
kyoto_teramachi_yoshikura.notes: [Japanese & obanzai · Teramachi-Imadegawa, refills on the house] A counter-and-tatami restaurant east of the Imperial Palace run by a chef trained in Okura and Royal hotel kitchens, beloved at lunch for set meals with unlimited obanzai and rice — okara, hijiki, pumpkin, simmered satoimo — beside sashimi, tempura or Saikyo-grilled fish, ¥2,300–4,200. Dinner is kaiseki and soy-milk hot pot. One diner found the seasoning on the sweet side; obanzai are now served by staff rather than self-serve. Lunch cash or PayPay. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 谷口 寿幸 (owner-chef, per the official site; no reading in a source)
roles: Owner and chef (official site: 店主 / 料理人 谷口 寿幸)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: trained in Japanese cooking at the Kobe Oriental Hotel from 1991 (Heisei 3) and in Kyoto cuisine at 京大和, then worked at the Rihga Royal Hotel Tokyo, Hotel Okura Tokyo and Hotel Okura Kyoto, often cooking at the state guesthouse and the Prime Minister’s residence; opened 寺町よしくら independently in 2006 (Heisei 18). The site also lists a sister shop, よしくら 北店, in Kita-ku, and sells Saikyo-marinated black cod and pickles online.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: to keep improving ingredients and menu and never forget the beginner’s mind, thanks to guests and staff.
chef_bio.specialty: All-you-can-eat obanzai lunch; Saikyo-miso grilled fish.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular noticed the obanzai, once self-served from bowls on the counter, are now refilled by the staff on request.
"Please feel free to ask for more anytime," a staff member told an October 2026 diner asking for refills.
A September 2026 visitor near the Futaba mochi shop found the obanzai and sukiyaki bowl on the sweet side — recommended for those who like sweet flavours.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (teramachiyoshikura.com): 寺町よしくら、御所東の本格和食、旬の魚介と京野菜、数々の有名ホテルで経験を積んだ匠、ランチはお惣菜6〜7品が食べ放題 (信州牛のステーキ御膳、京風すき焼き重、鰻重、限定20食の西京焼定食など)、夜は限定会席、豆乳鍋、和歌山産天然クエのあら煮、日本酒・焼酎、京都美山のキヌヒカリ、店主・料理人 谷口 寿幸: 平成3年神戸オリエンタルホテルで日本料理の修業、京大和で京料理、リーガロイヤルホテル東京、ホテル・オークラ東京、ホテル・オークラ京都、迎賓館や総理公邸での調理、平成18年に独立、昼11:00〜14:00 (L.O.)、夜17:00〜21:00 (L.O.)、火曜休み、よしくら 北店、楽天の通販 (銀だら西京漬け、漬物)。食べログ: 日本料理・居酒屋・海鮮、上京区寺町通今出川下ル真如堂前町102、出町柳駅から徒歩5分、11:00〜14:30・17:00〜22:00、火曜休み、ランチは現金か PayPay のみ、サービス料なし、20席 (カウンター10、座敷10)、禁煙、子供可 (授乳室やおむつ替えの設備なし)、2006年11月13日オープン。口コミ (2026年8月〜11月、英語): おばんざい食べ放題 (おから、ひじき、南瓜、里芋、がんも、厚揚げ、赤こんにゃく、切り干し大根)、ご飯おかわり自由、日替わり2,300円、鯖の味噌焼き2,400円、お造り御膳4,200円、銀だらや鯖の西京焼き、すき焼き丼、以前はセルフで今はスタッフがよそう、甘めの味付けという声、ランチは予約がおすすめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Choose a lunch set; staff refill obanzai on request; lunch cash or PayPay only.

kyoto_westin_miyako_raku.gf_detail: Ask the staff: Tabelog says allergy information is available. The buffet mixes tempura, bread, pasta and noodles with sushi, roast beef and rice dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_westin_miyako_raku.vegan_detail: Ask: allergy information is available (Tabelog); salads, vegetables and rice are on the buffet, but most stations serve fish, meat or eggs (2026 reviews).
kyoto_westin_miyako_raku.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri 6:30–21:00; Sat–Sun 6:30–22:00 — breakfast, lunch (a 90-minute course, September 2026), afternoon tea and dinner buffets. Service charge 15% (Tabelog; Japanese original 「15％」); an August 2026 breakfast guest paid ¥5,000 per adult and ¥2,500 per child (4–12) including tax and service. One child under school age eats free with each paying adult (August and October 2026). Bookings taken; dinner guests may enter about 10 minutes early (August 2026). 186 seats; a private room for 24 or more; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; parking 2 hours free with ¥3,000 spent; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Opened 27 November 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_westin_miyako_raku.notes: [Hotel buffet · Keage, The Westin Miyako Kyoto] The Westin Miyako’s all-day buffet room, with a window view of the Daimonji on the hill: breakfast of onigiri and dashimaki made in front of you, and at dinner sushi to order, fresh tempura and roast beef from live kitchens. Families love that a preschooler eats free with each adult; others found the menu barely changes with the seasons and lines at the sushi station long. 15% service. Open daily from 6:30.

roles: Hotel restaurant of The Westin Miyako Kyoto (official hotel site); chefs not named
chef_bio.background: The all-day buffet restaurant of The Westin Miyako Kyoto in Keage (hotel site; Tabelog). Opened 27 November 2019 (Tabelog). An October 2026 reviewer had stayed at the hotel almost every year since it was the Miyako Hotel.
chef_bio.philosophy: Tabelog: a buffet put together with care, in a spacious room with plenty of distance between tables.
chef_bio.specialty: Live-kitchen onigiri and dashimaki at breakfast; sushi and tempura at dinner.

anecdotes.text: "The cost performance is great, and the food is delicious, but it’s a bit disappointing that the menu doesn’t change significantly with each season." — August 2026, a regular.
An August 2026 family ate dinner looking out at the Daimonji on the hill through the window.
On an October 2026 weekend about 80% of the guests were families with small children.

cultural_comfort.note: International hotel buffet; point and serve yourself; live-kitchen staff cook to order.

kyoto_issunboushi_kiyomizu.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: every bowl is wheat noodles, the vegan ramen included; the shoyu broths use soy sauce (Savor Japan menu; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_issunboushi_kiyomizu.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: a KYOTO VEGAN NOODLE (¥1,500) and a morning vegan ramen (¥800), described on the Savor Japan menu as made without animal or seafood stock, with white miso, rice malt and soy milk; a September 2026 diner had the soy-milk vegan ramen with tomato and olive oil. Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options. All other bowls use chicken, seafood or shellfish broths and meat toppings. In June 2025 a reviewer saw a vegan ramen remade after ground meat had been added to it by mistake — say clearly that you need the vegan bowl.
kyoto_issunboushi_kiyomizu.hours_raw: Mon, Thu–Sun and the day before a holiday 8:00–20:30 (food L.O. 20:00); Tue, holidays and the day after a holiday 8:00–18:30 (L.O. 18:00); Wed 8:00–18:00 (L.O. 18:00). Breakfast menu until 10:30, then the full menu until the day’s 100 bowls sell out — the shop closes when the noodles run out. Open year-round (Tabelog; the shop’s own note on the same page gives breakfast from 7:00 to 11:00, which disagrees). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR codes accepted (Tabelog); orders by tablet at the seat in January 2026, by ticket machine in July 2025. 10 counter seats, L-shaped; office and restroom upstairs (Tabelog; August 2025). Non-smoking (Tabelog). English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese and Korean menus with photos; children welcome, kids’ menu, strollers OK (Tabelog). Waits of about 40 min on a Sunday afternoon (March 2026). A tips box sits by the ticket machine (June 2025). 2 min from Kiyomizu-michi bus stop, 5 min from Kiyomizu-dera’s Niomon Gate (Tabelog). Opened 26 February 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_issunboushi_kiyomizu.notes: [Ramen · below Kiyomizu-dera, breakfast bowls from 8:00] A ten-seat counter on the walk down from Kiyomizu-dera, open from 8:00 with a morning menu (a ¥500 bowl, a vegan bowl, porridge) and then ramen until the day’s 100 bowls are gone. Light shellfish and chicken-seafood shoyu and salt broths, a vegan soy-milk ramen, and showpiece bowls up to a ¥7,000 Wagyu sirloin. Most diners are overseas visitors; multilingual menus. Reviews split: fans of the clean broth, critics of the prices (one 2025 reviewer called the ¥7,000 bowl an overcharge aimed at foreigners), slow turnover and a drop in quality noted in October 2026.

chef_bio.background: A June 2025 reviewer saw “the male owner” training a new staff member at the counter. A March 2025 reviewer described the team as two Brazilian staff who “seem to be working hard but are not adequately trained” and “one unfriendly Japanese chef”; a January 2026 reviewer wrote that “most of the staff are also from abroad”. An August 2025 family wished more staff besides the manager spoke English.
chef_bio.specialty: Light shellfish and chicken-seafood shoyu ramen; morning ramen; a vegan soy-milk ramen.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 regular, on a twelfth visit, came for the morning ramen and noted the broth had changed from clam to chicken and seafood.
A June 2025 visitor found a tips box by the ticket machine and glasses of foreign banknotes on the tables, and arrived to find only the morning menu served until 10:30.
An October 2026 repeat visitor found the quality much lower than six months earlier and the prices sharply higher.

vegan_cross_contact.text: A June 2025 reviewer watched a vegan ramen being remade after ground meat had been added to it; the vegan bowls are cooked at the same counter as the meat and seafood bowls.

positives.text: Dedicated vegan ramen (KYOTO VEGAN NOODLE, morning vegan ramen) made without animal or seafood stock, per the Savor Japan menu.

kyoto_sakana_naminami.gf_detail: Ask. Natural-fish courses and à la carte — sashimi with soy sauce, grilled and fried fish, tempura, agedashi tofu, seasoned rice; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sakana_naminami.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish restaurant; dobin-mushi and dashi dishes (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sakana_naminami.hours_raw: 17:00–22:30, Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards: VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 18 seats (Tabelog); a February 2025 reviewer saw only counter seating. Non-smoking (Tabelog). A reviewer (April 2024) calls it an adult space and asks families with children to stay away. On Fuyacho south of Nijo, 350 m from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog). Opened 11 April 2003 (Tabelog); two reviewers (June 2024, February 2025) think it was recently renovated.
kyoto_sakana_naminami.notes: [Fish · Fuyacho-Nijo, wild fish since 2003] A natural-fish restaurant on a quiet stretch of Fuyacho, open since 2003, where the fish is cut and cooked in front of the counter. Go for a course — ten dishes for ¥15,000, or the top course with a ten-item hassun, rock oysters, five kinds of sashimi and hamo sashimi in summer — or order à la carte, though a 2024 diner found that very expensive (¥8,800 for the sashimi platter). Reviewers like the friendly chef; one asks families with children to stay away.

chef_bio.background: A July 2017 reviewer described “the friendly surf-loving chef” who “specializes in natural seafood dishes”; an August 2024 reviewer called the head chef “friendly and approachable”, and a November 2025 guest enjoyed the conversation at the counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Natural-fish courses; hamo sashimi in summer.

anecdotes.text: Three July 2026 reviewers on business dinners each rated the hamo sashimi the best ever eaten; the staff told one that it runs until about October, best in September.
A June 2024 diner found the prices well above those in older photos: sashimi platter ¥8,800, dashimaki ¥1,500.

cultural_comfort.note: No English menu listed; counter dining with a chef reviewers find friendly.

kyoto_nijo_kizuki.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi courses with small dishes; nigiri often seasoned with salt, sauces such as seaweed soy and vinegar miso, Saikyo-miso grilled fish, miso soup; no gluten information (Tabelog shop text; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nijo_kizuki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses only, of fish and sushi, with fish-bone miso soup (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nijo_kizuki.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30 (last seating 13:30), dinner 17:00–22:00 (last seating 21:00), Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservation only; same-day bookings have worked (May and June 2026). The shop’s rules (Tabelog): “We do not allow visitors wearing perfume or other items with strong smells. In this case, a cancellation fee will also be charged.” Arriving more than 15 minutes late counts as a cancellation. “In order for you to enjoy your meal in a relaxed manner, we do not allow children under the age of 13 to enter our restaurant.” Cards: VISA, Master, AMEX; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 10 seats: 6 at the counter, 4 at a table (Tabelog); a January 2026 regular counted eight at the counter. Private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking, ashtray outside; wheelchair users can sit at a table (Tabelog). On Nijo-dori east of Yanagibaba, 7 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae and Karasuma Oike Stns (Tabelog). Opened 26 July 2014 (Tabelog).
kyoto_nijo_kizuki.notes: [Sushi · Nijo-dori, a one-man counter, no perfume] A glass-fronted, café-like room on Nijo-dori, easy to walk past but for the lantern, where the owner works the counter alone: seasonal small dishes, then ten or twelve slim nigiri on small red-vinegar shari, with sake tasting sets. Lunch from ¥3,300, dinner courses from ¥8,800. Reservation only; no perfume or strong scents (a cancellation fee applies) and no children under 13. Some find the service reserved.

chef_bio.origin: Yamaguchi (Tabelog shop text: “sake from the owner’s hometown, Yamaguchi”)
chef_bio.background: A January 2026 regular names the master as Mr. Morimoto and writes that the family runs a ryotei. Reviewers describe a one-man counter: “Although it was a one-person operation, the speed of food and drink service was good” (June 2026); the owner was alone on an early May 2026 evening and talked at length with the only guest. A February 2026 reviewer, echoing others, found the service “a bit cold … more welcoming to regular customers”; an August 2026 lunch guest noted little conversation but smooth service.
chef_bio.philosophy: Ingredients chosen by the owner at the market, carefully prepared and often seasoned with salt (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Sushi courses with creative small dishes; uni ice with sesame tofu; sake tastings.

anecdotes.text: On an early May 2026 evening with no other guests, the owner shared stories with the one diner, and the sake cups had each sake’s name written underneath; the owner seemed especially fond of Omachi-rice sake.
A January 2026 regular booked the same day and time as the year before for the New Year dishes and white-miso zoni.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 二條 葵月、寿司・創作料理・日本料理、中京区二条通柳馬場東入ル晴明町659 ヴァインオークFINE 1F、京都市役所前駅・烏丸御池駅から徒歩7分、月〜土 昼12:00〜14:30 (最終入店13:30)、夜17:00〜22:00 (最終入店21:00)、日曜定休、完全予約制、香水など強い香りの方は入店不可 (キャンセル料あり)、15分以上の遅れはキャンセル扱い、13歳未満は入店不可、カード可 (VISA、Master、AMEX)、10席 (カウンター6、テーブル4)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、2014年7月26日オープン。店の紹介: 店主が市場で選ぶ魚を塩で仕上げることが多い、ウニのアイスと胡麻豆腐、店主の故郷 Yamaguchi の日本酒。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 店主 Morimoto、実家は料亭、ひとりで営む、昼のコース3,300円、夜8,800円、米酢と赤酢のシャリ、日本酒の飲み比べ、接客はやや冷たいとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: No foreign-booking restriction stated; reviewers note many international guests (October 2026). Strict house rules: no perfume or strong scents (cancellation fee), no children under 13, 15 minutes late counts as a cancellation (Tabelog).

kyoto_shunsai_sakuya.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal small dishes, sashimi, charcoal-grilled fish, tempura and fried dishes, ankake, nigiri with clam dashi, nyumen; no gluten information (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shunsai_sakuya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based seasonal cooking of fish and shellfish (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shunsai_sakuya.hours_raw: 18:00–22:00, Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; booked out on a November 2022 evening, when à la carte guests were still fitted in (Tabelog; November 2022). No credit cards; e-money accepted; no QR (Tabelog). 19 seats: 11 at the counter and two tatami tables for 8 (Tabelog). Half portions available, useful for solo diners (April 2025). 5 min from Imadegawa-Omiya and Imadegawa-Jofukuji bus stops (Tabelog).
kyoto_shunsai_sakuya.notes: [Seasonal Japanese · Nishijin, a couple’s counter] A cosy counter-and-tatami room near Imadegawa-Omiya, between izakaya and formal kappo, run by the chef and the chef’s wife. Take the ¥6,000 nine-dish omakase or order à la carte — generous ¥500 obanzai, charcoal-grilled river fish, seasonal tempura, nigiri — with about ten Kansai sakes. Half portions make it easy alone. No credit cards (e-money OK).

roles: Chef (unnamed) and the chef’s wife, who run it as a couple
chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe the chef cooking with the chef’s wife serving: the chef and the chef’s wife “were attentive and thoughtful” (December 2023); “the owner’s wife kindly took our coats and served us warm tea” (March 2024); “it seems that now the husband and wife are running the place together” (February 2026). In November 2022 a reviewer saw the chef alone in the kitchen with one service staff member.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal omakase and à la carte; obanzai; charcoal-grilled fish.

anecdotes.text: On a fully booked November 2022 night, two à la carte guests felt the chef balanced the à la carte orders with the course guests’ without pushing the pair to the back of the line.
A December 2023 diner ordered one serving of nigiri and the companion was given an extra bowl of the clam dashi free.
